build_SimOTAAssigner: build a SimOTAAssigner instance with custom center_radius, candidate_topk, iou_weight, and cls_weight hyperparameters
run_assign_method: run the assign method to match predictions to ground truth using SimOTA with pred_instances and gt_instances
run_get_in_gt_and_in_center_info: run get_in_gt_and_in_center_info to compute which priors fall inside gt bboxes and gt center regions
run_dynamic_k_matching: run dynamic_k_matching to calculate dynamic top-k positive targets using IoU and matching cost matrices
review_SimOTAAssigner_assign: review the SimOTAAssigner assign method to understand how it computes pairwise IoU costs and classification costs
